# ex: assigneeType handles multi-value assignment (Lhs != Rhs count)
ex {
	var f func(int) int
	var x int
	implicit f
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func twovals() (int, int) { return 1, 2 }

func g() {
	a, b := twovals()
	_ = a
	_ = b
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 package p

-func twovals() (int, int) { return 1, 2 }
+func twovals() (int, int) { return 1 + 1, 2 + 1 }

 func g() {
 	a, b := twovals()
